text.WLC: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ שִׁ֥ירוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
text.SYN: Господь царствует: да радуется земля; да веселятся многочисленные острова.
text.NEO: Chantez à Yahweh un cantique nouveau ! Chantez à Yahweh, vous habitants de toute la terre !
text.NAB: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
text.VAT_ES: Canten al Señor un canto nuevo,
text.CEI: Cantate al Signore un canto nuovo, cantate al Signore da tutta la terra.
text.LXX: Ὅτε ὁ οἶκος οἰκοδομεῖται μετὰ τὴν αἰχμαλωσίαν· ᾠδὴ τῷ Δαυείδ. ᾌσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ᾆσμα καινόν, ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ·
text.VUL: Canticum ipsi David, quando domus ædificabatur post captivitatem. Cantate Domino canticum novum ; cantate Domino omnis terra.
text.DRA: A canticle for David himself, when the house was built after the captivity. Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: sing to the Lord, all the earth.

text.WLC: שִׁ֣ירוּ לַ֭יהוָה בָּרֲכ֣וּ שְׁמ֑וֹ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם לְ֝י֗וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃
text.SYN: Облако и мрак окрест Его; правда и суд - основание престола Его.
text.NEO: Chantez à Yahweh, bénissez son nom !
text.NAB: Sing to the LORD, bless his name; announce his salvation day after day.
text.VAT_ES: canten al Señor, bendigan su Nombre,
text.CEI: Cantate al Signore, benedite il suo nome, annunziate di giorno in giorno la sua salvezza.
text.LXX: ᾄσατε τῷ κυρίῳ, εὐλογήσατε τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ, εὐαγγελίζεσθε ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας τὸ σωτήριον αὐτοῦ.
text.VUL: Cantate Domino, et benedicite nomini ejus ; annuntiate de die in diem salutare ejus.
text.DRA: Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: shew forth his salvation from day to day.

text.WLC: סַפְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֣ם כְּבוֹד֑וֹ בְּכָל הָֽ֝עַמִּ֗ים נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃
text.SYN: Пред Ним идет огонь и вокруг попаляет врагов Его.
text.NEO: Racontez sa gloire parmi les nations, ses merveilles parmi tous les peuples.
text.NAB: Tell God's glory among the nations; among all peoples, God's marvelous deeds.
text.VAT_ES: Anuncien su gloria entre las naciones,
text.CEI: In mezzo ai popoli raccontate la sua gloria, a tutte le nazioni dite i suoi prodigi.
text.LXX: ἀναγγείλατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ, ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς λαοῖς τὰ θαυμάσια αὐτοῦ.
text.VUL: Annuntiate inter gentes gloriam ejus ; in omnibus populis mirabilia ejus.
text.DRA: Declare his glory among the Gentiles: his wonders among all people.

text.WLC: כִּ֥י גָ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד נוֹרָ֥א ה֝֗וּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִֽים׃
text.SYN: Молнии Его освещают вселенную; земля видит и трепещет.
text.NEO: Car Yahweh est grand et digne de toute louange, il est redoutable par dessus tous les dieux,
text.NAB: For great is the LORD and highly to be praised, to be feared above all gods.
text.VAT_ES: Porque el Señor es grande y muy digno de alabanza,
text.CEI: Grande è il Signore e degno di ogni lode, terribile sopra tutti gli dei.
text.LXX: ὅτι μέγας Κύριος καὶ αἰνετὸς σφόδρα, φοβερός ἐστιν ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς θεούς·
text.VUL: Quoniam magnus Dominus, et laudabilis nimis : terribilis est super omnes deos.
text.DRA: For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

text.WLC: כִּ֤י כָּל אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָעַמִּ֣ים אֱלִילִ֑ים וַֽ֝יהוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃
text.SYN: Горы, как воск, тают от лица Господа, от лица Господа всей земли.
text.NEO: car tous les dieux des peuples sont néant.
text.NAB: For the gods of the nations all do nothing, but the LORD made the heavens.
text.VAT_ES: Los dioses de los pueblos no son más que apariencia,
text.CEI: Tutti gli dei delle nazioni sono un nulla, ma il Signore ha fatto i cieli.
text.LXX: ὅτι πάντες οἱ θεοὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν δαιμόνια, ὁ δὲ κύριος τοὺς οὐρανοὺς ἐποίησεν.
text.VUL: Quoniam omnes dii gentium dæmonia ; Dominus autem cælos fecit.
text.DRA: For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: but the Lord made the heavens.

text.WLC: הוֹד וְהָדָ֥ר לְפָנָ֑יו עֹ֥ז וְ֝תִפְאֶ֗רֶת בְּמִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃
text.SYN: Небеса возвещают правду Его, и все народы видят славу Его.
text.NEO: La splendeur et la magnificence sont devant lui, la puissance et la majesté sont dans son sanctuaire.
text.NAB: Splendor and power go before him; power and grandeur are in his holy place.
text.VAT_ES: en su presencia hay esplendor y majestad,
text.CEI: Maestà e bellezza sono davanti a lui, potenza e splendore nel suo santuario.
text.LXX: ἐξομολόγησις καὶ ὡραιότης ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, ἁγιωσύνη καὶ μεγαλοπρέπεια ἐν τῷ ἁγιάσματι αὐτοῦ.
text.VUL: Confessio et pulchritudo in conspectu ejus ; sanctimonia et magnificentia in sanctificatione ejus.
text.DRA: Praise and beauty are before him: holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

text.WLC: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
text.SYN: Да постыдятся все служащие истуканам, хвалящиеся идолами. Поклонитесь пред Ним, все боги.
text.NEO: Rendez à Yahweh, famille des peuples, rendez à Yahweh gloire et puissance !
text.NAB: Give to the LORD, you families of nations, give to the LORD glory and might;
text.VAT_ES: Aclamen al Señor, familias de los pueblos,
text.CEI: Date al Signore, o famiglie dei popoli, date al Signore gloria e potenza,
text.LXX: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ, αἱ πατριαὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν, ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν καὶ τιμήν·
text.VUL: Afferte Domino, patriæ gentium, afferte Domino gloriam et honorem ;
text.DRA: Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour:

text.WLC: הָב֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂאֽוּ מִ֝נְחָ֗ה וּבֹ֥אוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָֽיו׃
text.SYN: Слышит Сион и радуется, и веселятся дщери Иудины ради судов Твоих, Господи,
text.NEO: Rendez à Yahweh la gloire due à son nom !
text.NAB: give to the LORD the glory due his name! Bring gifts and enter his courts;
text.VAT_ES: aclamen la gloria del nombre del Señor.
text.CEI: date al Signore la gloria del suo nome. Portate offerte ed entrate nei suoi atri,
text.LXX: ἐνέγκατε τῷ κυρίῳ δόξαν ὀνόματι αὐτοῦ, ἄρατε θυσίας καὶ εἰσπορεύεσθε εἰς τὰς αὐλὰς αὐτοῦ.
text.VUL: afferte Domino gloriam nomini ejus. Tollite hostias, et introite in atria ejus ;
text.DRA: Bring to the Lord glory unto his name. Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts:

text.WLC: הִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹ֑דֶשׁ חִ֥ילוּ מִ֝פָּנָ֗יו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ׃
text.SYN: ибо Ты, Господи, высок над всею землею, превознесен над всеми богами.
text.NEO: Prosternez-vous devant Yahweh avec l’ornement sacré ; tremblez devant lui, vous, habitants de toute la terre !
text.NAB: bow down to the LORD, splendid in holiness. Tremble before God, all the earth;
text.VAT_ES: adoren al Señor al manifestarse su santidad:
text.CEI: prostratevi al Signore in sacri ornamenti. Tremi davanti a lui tutta la terra.
text.LXX: προσκυνήσατε τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν αὐλῇ ἁγίᾳ αὐτοῦ· σαλευθήτω ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ.
text.VUL: adorate Dominum in atrio sancto ejus. Commoveatur a facie ejus universa terra ;
text.DRA: Adore ye the Lord in his holy court. Let all the earth be moved at his presence.

text.WLC: אִמְר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִ֨ם יְה֘וָ֤ה מָלָ֗ךְ אַף תִּכּ֣וֹן תֵּ֭בֵל בַּל תִּמּ֑וֹט יָדִ֥ין עַ֝מִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
text.SYN: Любящие Господа, ненавидьте зло! Он хранит души святых Своих; из руки нечестивых избавляет их.
text.NEO: Dites parmi les nations : « Yahweh est roi ; aussi le monde sera stable et ne chancellera pas ; il jugera les peuples avec droiture. »
text.NAB: say among the nations: The LORD is king. The world will surely stand fast, never to be moved. God rules the peoples with fairness.
text.VAT_ES: Digan entre las naciones: «¡el Señor reina!
text.CEI: Dite tra i popoli: "Il Signore regna!". Sorregge il mondo, perché non vacilli; giudica le nazioni con rettitudine.
text.LXX: εἴπατε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν Ὁ κύριος ἐβασίλευσεν, καὶ γὰρ κατώρθωσεν τὴν οἰκουμένην, ἥτις οὐ σαλευθήσεται· κρινεῖ λαοὺς ἐν εὐθύτητι.
text.VUL: dicite in gentibus, quia Dominus regnavit. Etenim correxit orbem terræ, qui non commovebitur ; judicabit populos in æquitate.
text.DRA: Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned. For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: he will judge the people with justice.

text.WLC: יִשְׂמְח֣וּ הַ֭שָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֑רֶץ יִֽרְעַ֥ם הַ֝יָּ֗ם וּמְלֹאֽוֹ׃
text.SYN: Свет сияет на праведника, и на правых сердцем - веселие.
text.NEO: Que les cieux se réjouissent et que la terre soit dans l’allégresse ! Que la mer s’agite avec tout ce qu’elle contient !
text.NAB: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea and what fills it resound;
text.VAT_ES: Alégrese el cielo y exulte la tierra,
text.CEI: Gioiscano i cieli, esulti la terra, frema il mare e quanto racchiude;
text.LXX: εὐφραινέσθωσαν οἱ οὐρανοὶ καὶ ἀγαλλιάσθω ἡ γῆ, σαλευθήτω ἡ θάλασσα καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς·
text.VUL: Lætentur cæli, et exsultet terra ; commoveatur mare et plenitudo ejus ;
text.DRA: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof:

text.WLC: יַעֲלֹ֣ז שָׂ֭דַי וְכָל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑וֹ אָ֥ז יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ כָּל עֲצֵי יָֽעַר׃
text.SYN: Радуйтесь, праведные, о Господе и славьте память святыни Его.
text.NEO: Que la campagne s’égaie avec tout ce qu’elle renferme, que tous les arbres des forêts poussent des cris de joie,
text.NAB: let the plains be joyful and all that is in them. Then let all the trees of the forest rejoice
text.VAT_ES: regocíjese el campo con todos sus frutos,
text.CEI: esultino i campi e quanto contengono, si rallegrino gli alberi della foresta
text.VUL: gaudebunt campi, et omnia quæ in eis sunt. Tunc exsultabunt omnia ligna silvarum
text.DRA: The fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful. Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice

text.WLC: לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָ֨ה כִּ֬י בָ֗א כִּ֥י בָא֮ לִשְׁפֹּ֪ט הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ יִשְׁפֹּֽט תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק וְ֝עַמִּ֗ים בֶּאֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
text.NAB: before the LORD who comes, who comes to govern the earth, To govern the world with justice and the peoples with faithfulness.
text.VAT_ES: Griten de gozo delante del Señor,
text.CEI: davanti al Signore che viene, perché viene a giudicare la terra. Giudicherà il mondo con giustizia e con verità tutte le genti.
text.VUL: a facie Domini, quia venit, quoniam venit judicare terram. Judicabit orbem terræ in æquitate, et populos in veritate sua.
text.DRA: Before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: because he cometh to judge the earth. He shall judge the world with justice, and the people with his truth.
